OCR request returning multiple pages of document content

```ruby title="Ruby"

result = LiterLlm.ocr(LiterLlm::OcrRequest.new(document: { 'type' => 'document_url', 'url' => 'https://example.com/multipage.pdf' }, model: 'mistral/mistral-ocr-latest'))
puts result.inspect
```
